name: Assault
description: Execute aggressive physical or localized digital attacks.

name: Firewall
description: Deploy defensive barriers to mitigate incoming damage.

name: Compile
description: Construct, modify, and manipulate data structures.

name: Shred
description: Tear complex data and files apart into raw, unusable scraps.

name: Scan
description: Probe the environment to find hidden data or enemy vulnerabilities.

name: Parse
description: Analyze and break down massive strings of data into recognizable, logical parts.

name: Datamine
description: Deeply research and extract specific, buried information from vast databases.

name: Override
description: Use sheer computational resolve to push past restrictions or resist system subjugation.

name: Sync
description: Negotiate communication protocols to peacefully interact with or persuade other systems.

name: Spoof
description: Deceive or trick other systems by falsifying data or identity.

name: Compression
description: Forcefully condense data or crush digital structures to reduce size or inflict pressure.
